name: Ayinla Kollington
description: '''General Ayinla Kollington''' {{Audio|General_Ayinla_Kollington.wav|listen}} (born 20 August 1949), born Abdulrasaq Kolawole Ilori to Chief Ayanda Ilori, a Kingmaker and Alhaja Asiawu Mofodeke Ilori. He is a [[Nigerians|Nigerian]] [[Fuji music|Fuji]] musician and one of the pioneers of the [[genre]]. He hailed from Ilota, a town on the outskirts of [[Ilorin]], [[Kwara State]], [[Nigeria]]. He is also called Baba Alatika, Kebe-n-Kwara, Baba Alagbado.
